figures.caption: Figure 1: Overview of DecoupleMix. (a) Recipe search: annotated datasets are optimized along two decoupled axes—inter-class budget allocation and intra-class convex selection—then validated and scaled up on a cheap proxy model (2.5B→10B tokens). (b) Dynamic admission: a new dataset is evaluated under the fixed configuration, turning its acceptance into a controlled, attributable integrate-or-reject decision.
